entries.title: Job 25:1
segments: ¶Then answered Bildad the Shuhite, and said,

entries.title: Job 25:2
segments: Dominion and fear [are] with him, he maketh peace in his high places.

entries.title: Job 25:3
segments: Is there any number of his armies? and upon whom doth not his light arise?

words.text: ? and upon whom doth not his light

entries.title: Job 25:4
segments: How then can man be justified with God? or how can he be clean [that is] born of a woman?

words.text: ? or how can he be clean

entries.title: Job 25:5
segments: Behold even to the moon, and it shineth not; yea, the stars are not pure in his sight.

entries.title: Job 25:6
segments: How much less man, [that is] a worm? and the son of man, [which is] a worm?
